response.justification: The candidate is a capable, versatile senior engineer with nearly two decades of experience, strong software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD), some high-scale distributed systems exposure at Sociomantic, and recent AI-agent tooling work. However, the resume shows no experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, telemetry infrastructure, or statistical analysis — the core domain of this role — and no evidence of Principal/IC6-level scope such as leading multi-team, multi-workstream initiatives or building platforms adopted across many teams. The gap between senior full-stack product work and principal-level growth/experimentation platform ownership is substantial.
strengths: 18+ years of engineering experience across web, backend, mobile, and embedded, exceeding the 8-year language proficiency bar
High-scale distributed systems experience (low-latency services handling millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic)
Recent hands-on AI tooling work (MCP code generators, agentic workflows) aligning with the AI-first emphasis
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth measurement platform experience anywhere in the resume
No demonstrated telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical analysis background, a required qualification
Career trajectory is senior/staff IC on product teams; no evidence of principal-level cross-org technical leadership or systems adopted by multiple teams

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and scale experience
